messages:
june: FYI we got the LiftBridge model submission package. They want marketplace listing + optional HW-bundle. Need legal + export review before we publish.
omar: Great. Did they include the weights license? link: https://files.liftbridge.ai/lift-3b/LICENSE.txt
lina: I skimmed — it's a custom permissive with an attribution clause and a geo-restriction paragraph. Concern: clause 4 could conflict with marketplace redistribution policy.
kevin: Can you paste clause 4? want to check product implications.
lina: Sure:
```
4. Redistribution: Model may be redistributed, provided downstream recipients agree to ProhibitedRegions list. The Provider may update ProhibitedRegions with 30 days notice.
```
raj: :thinking: The automatic ProhibitedRegions update without a joint approval is risky for marketplace SKUs. We can't change geo-blocking on live listings unilaterally.
sara: +1. Ops-wise we'd need an API to toggle geoblocking, and marketplace-bot needs to enforce per-SKU allowed regions.
marketplace-bot: [automated] Current marketplace policy: vendor-driven regional blocks require legal signoff + 14-day notice to customers.
omar: LiftBridge expects us to host quantized weights in the HW-bundle (partner GPU vendors). Any export controls on quantized vs float32?
lina: Export controls treat models by capability, not number format. But shipping on physical HW across borders triggers additional customs and ECC checks. We'll need an export checklist.
june: Action items:
- Lina draft an addendum that tightens clause 4 to require mutual consent for region changes (due EOD Tue).
- Kevin + Raj: confirm we can implement per-SKU region toggles and surface them in Console (PT by Fri).
- Omar: ask LiftBridge for a signed MSA + origin-of-weights proof and provenance docs.
- Sara: confirm HW partners can host quantized weights and accept export paperwork.

omar: I'll ping LiftBridge now. Suggested message: "We can list but need MSA + provenance + a mutual geoblock update process. Also please confirm export classification." Will post and share replies here.
june: Thanks. Also propose we offer two SKUs: "Hosted (Redwood-managed)" and "HW-bundle (partner-hosted)" with clear lisence bullets in listing.
kevin: For the listing copy, avoid legalese. Example bullet:
- "Model weights provided under Partner License; geo-restrictions may apply — contact us for export & deployment guidance."
lina: I'll prep the short legal blurb for the listing + a rider for the MSA.
raj: FYI, engineering constraint: we can honor per-customer geoblock only if customers use Dedicated/Private. Hosted tenants would need tenant-level controls — complexity to estimate.
sara: Noted. I'll scope with two HW vendors (NimbleEdge, ForgeOne) and confirm packaging timelines.
marketplace-bot: [automated] New action created: #PRJ-4982 "LiftBridge onboarding - legal & marketplace". Assignees: omar, lina, kevin.
omar: thanks — updating LiftBridge now. Will paste their response here.
june: Perfect. If LiftBridge insists on unilateral updates, we have to escalate to execs. Keep thread tight. :lock:
